name: Hsu Fu-Hsing
source: John Shen's assistant, Frankie, befriended John by chance and set out alongside him on his journey to solve strange cases. Frankie has the ability to create an assortment of inventions to help the protagonist deal with numerous mechanisms and conundrums throughout investigations.
